Hi Niel,

Fair question, and I'm sorry it's felt that way. We're a small team, and several of us answer in this same thread. I'm Sarah, the first point of contact. Abel and Georges step in when something needs a decision. The mixed answers on the S1 are on us. Georges's last reply is where it stands: the unit came back to us, and you get store credit for the full amount of the S1 order.

You've said yes, so a colleague is issuing the credit today and will confirm the amount in this thread. I've also passed on that you'd still rather have a refund. That hasn't changed the decision, but it's on record.

You asked what's available. Neither of the bigger units ships today. The Harlo B30 (30 TH/s, $899) ships October 30. A new Magic Miner 40T order ($799) is Batch 5 and ships November 14. The credit covers most of either one.

The Magic Miner 40T already on order Shop···· ships October 31. The shipping notice with tracking goes to this email address automatically as soon as it leaves. It's worth marking us as a safe sender so that email doesn't end up in spam.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
